实测（60 s × 3 种子，逐次）：不干预 6.1 / 8.6 / 11.2: Measured (60 s × 3 seeds, per run): no intervention 6.1 / 8.6 / 11.2 s; single knockout Clavicle 5.4 / 8.1 / 5.1, single knockout G2N-1 4.8 / 6.8 / 7.9; both together 2.8 / 2.9 / 2.0. The independent-multiplication expectation is 4.6 s, measured 2.6 s, so it really is synergy, not just addition
实测（60 s × 3 种子，逐次）：不干预起跳 33 / 32 / 33 次、: Measured (60 s × 3 seeds, per run): no intervention 33 / 32 / 33 takeoffs, dodge rate 0.85 / 0.84 / 0.95; after shuffling 18 / 5 / 0 takeoffs, dodge rate 0.07 / 0.79 / 0.43. **The criterion uses takeoff count, not dodge rate** — dodge rate fluctuates too much between runs (one shuffled run still got 0.79), whereas takeoff count fell below 20 in all three runs and stayed above 32 in all three no-intervention runs, with no overlap. This is also closer to the mechanism: what shuffling breaks first is the looming → giant fibre pathway
实测（60 s × 3 种子）：不干预峰值 35.3 Hz、均值 11.3；敲掉: Measured (60 s × 3 seeds): no intervention peak 35.3 Hz, mean 11.3; after knocking out Phantom peak 71.4, mean 20.2 — about 2.0×, in the same direction as the 2.06× measured in the sub-circuit and 3.02× in the whole brain. 实测（60 s × 3 种子）：不干预起跳 32 次、进食 8.7 s；切掉两条: Measured (60 s × 3 seeds): no intervention 32 takeoffs, 8.7 s feeding; after cutting both visual pathways 0 takeoffs, 10.6 s feeding — **feeding is actually longer**, because it is no longer interrupted by takeoffs
逃逸与进食是两条分开的通路：LC4/LPLC2 → 巨纤维管起飞，糖味 GRN: Escape and feeding are two separate pathways: LC4/LPLC2 → giant fibre controls takeoff, sugar GRN → MN9 controls proboscis extension. Cut the visual one and feeding is completely unharmed — the same thing as the whole-brain screen finding that 'the active neuron sets for sugar and water overlap only by a third, and the shared part lies near the outputs'.
这是本项目最反直觉的一条结果：**单独敲除看不到的东西，必须把两个一起敲才会出现: This is this project's most counter-intuitive result: **what a single knockout cannot show only appears when two are knocked out together**. Clavicle and G2N-1 knocked out alone each still leave 90% of feeding; together, feeding collapses by half — below the product that 'independent' effects would predict. The whole-brain screen has 10 such synergistic pairs (7 leave-one-out stable), and wiring alone cannot predict them (Spearman between path overlap and pair effect ≈ 0).
这是论文补充表 1D 的对照，也是对「这些数字果蝇其实是随机网络在乱按键」这一质: This is the control in the paper's Supplementary Table 1D, and a direct answer to the challenge that 'these digital flies are really just random networks mashing buttons': if performance stays the same after shuffling, the connectome is not doing anything. We measured: sugar → MN9 drops from 82.9 Hz to 3.5 ± 4.2 Hz. This mission uses the **takeoff in place** mode, because with real flight trajectories the dodge rate is close to 100% and no difference can be measured.
aBN1（SAD093）是梳理通路的绝对瓶颈：全脑筛选里单敲它让 aDN1 与: aBN1 (SAD093) is the absolute bottleneck of the grooming pathway: in the whole-brain screen, knocking it out alone drives both aDN1 and aDN2 to zero, which the experiments of Hampel et al. 2015 also confirm. In the sub-circuit it is likewise 59.8 → 0 Hz. Of the pathway's 596 active neurons, this is the only irreplaceable one.
Phantom（CB0062）是抑制性（GABA）的：敲掉它，**水**通路的: Phantom (CB0062) is inhibitory (GABA): knock it out and MN9 on the **water** pathway doubles — 3.02× in the whole brain, 2.06× in the sub-circuit. The same knockout has almost no effect on the **sugar** pathway (0.92 / 0.97). So any quote of this number must name the pathway.
Roundup（CB0553）是糖 → MN9 通路上效应最强的前运动神经元之一: Roundup (CB0553) is one of the premotor neurons with the strongest effect on the sugar → MN9 pathway: ratio 0.30 after whole-brain knockout, 0.05 in the sub-circuit. It is not on the escape pathway, so dodging balls is unaffected.
